Name: Closed Door Gifting
Author: ceddieeee
Description:
[b]Stop waiting outside Sebastian's room like a total creep.[/b]

In vanilla Stardew Valley, locked bedroom doors stay locked until 2 hearts. This mod solves that by letting you slip gifts right under locked NPC doors without needing to be invited in, saving you hours of in-game waiting!

[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]How it Works[/b][/size]
Interact with any locked NPC bedroom door while holding a giftable item.
[list]
[*][b]If the door is unlocked:[/b] The mod does nothing. The vanilla game takes over as normal.
[*][b]If the NPC is at home & the bedroom door is locked[/b]:
[list]
[*]The vanilla "locked door" message appears first, followed by a custom prompt asking if you'd like to leave your item as a gift.
[*][b]Shared Rooms:[/b] "Knocking" on bedroom doors with 2 NPCs (e.g., Robin & Demetrius's bedroom) will prompt you which NPC you want to gift to.
[*]The mod verifies your daily and weekly gift limits.
[*]Confirm -> the item is consumed, friendship increases, based on the set config.
[/list][/list]
[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
[b]1. 100% Vanilla Friendly[/b]
Door gifts count toward the standard 1-per-day and 2-per-week limits.

[b]2. Immersive & Silent Deliveries[/b]
This mod suppresses the vanilla reaction emotes during door-gifting, because nothing breaks immersion quite like a heart emote on top of the NPC you just gifted behind the door.

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod is fully compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/url] You can easily tweak the rules from the main menu or in-game:
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod[/b] ([i]true[/i]): Turn the mod on or off.
[*][b]Require NPC Met[/b] ([i]true[/i]): Only allow gifting through doors after you've formally introduced yourself to the NPC.
[*][b]Friendship Multiplier[/b] ([i]0.25[/i]): Leaving something at a door is arguably less personal than handing it directly. Adjust how much friendship a door gift is worth relative to a normal face-to-face gift. Range: 0.1–1.0.
[i]Note: Birthday gifts are strictly governed by vanilla rules! They are not affected by this multiplier and will always give the default birthday bonus.[/i][/list]
[size=3][b]Known Limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]No Business Transactions:[/b] You [b]cannot[/b] complete "Help Wanted" delivery quests by slipping the requested item under the door. If Haley wants a Super Cucumber, she has to look you in the eye and hand you the gold herself.
[*][b]Expansion Mods:[/b] This mod has been playtested to about 90% coverage in vanilla Stardew Valley. It has [i]not[/i] been officially tested with massive expansion mods like [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/i] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][i]Ridgeside Village[/i][/url]﻿. In theory, as long as those custom NPCs have standard bedroom doors built like the base game, it should work perfectly!
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*](Optional but highly recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to easily change your settings in game.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Delete the mod's folder from your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory. It is perfectly safe to add or remove mid-playthrough! (Realistically, you'll only need this mod in Year 1, where most of the NPCs are with below 2 hearts.)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Bug Reports[/b][/size]
Found a custom NPC whose door rejects your gifts? Let me know by posting it in the Post tab or filing a Github issue!
When reporting an issue, please include:
[list]
[*]Your [url=https://smapi.io/log][b]SMAPI Log[/b][/url].
[*]The name of the [b]problematic NPC[/b].
[*]The name of the [b]expansion mod[/b] they belong to.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Credits & Inspiration
[/b][/size][size=2]While the mechanics were built from the ground up, the core logic was heavily inspired by [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/632]this[/url] idea.

Translations are always welcome. Slip your translation files under my door (or just send them via the Post tab/GitHub) and I'll gladly pack them into the next update!
[/size][list]
[*]Chinese (Simplified) by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Herdore][b]Herdore[/b][/url]﻿

[/list]
[size=3][b]Support[/b][/size]
If this freed you from babysitting Robin's hallway waiting for a moody programmer to wake up, consider leaving an endorsement on the Nexus page. It goes a long way in helping others discover it. [b]Thank you for trying it out :)
